name: Sanada Hikosaburou
source: The oldest of the Haguro army's Four Heavenly Kings, he is deeply trusted by his comrades. Having endured countless brutal battles, he remains unflappable, inspiring confidence in his troops. More adept at defense than offense, he's often tasked with guarding key positions, earning him the moniker 'Unmovable Hikosaburou'. Gentle and approachable, but once his temper ignites, no one can stop him. Fiercely loyal, he would gladly lay down his life for his comrades. He is a renowned commander within the Haguro army.
